description: This file declares a utility function getProto that retrieves the prototype of an object, along with a constant reference x to this function which can also be null, and exports x.

methods.name: declare function getProto<O extends object>(object: O): object | null; getProto
methods.description: Retrieves the prototype of the specified object, returning null if the object has no prototype.

ctags.name: getProto
ctags.pattern: /^declare function getProto<O extends object>(object: O): object | null;$/
